name: AI Deep Dive — COHR — 2026-05-02
rationale: Coherent (COHR) is successfully capitalizing on the AI optical networking boom. With revenue growth accelerating and margins inflecting positively, the $61.7B valuation reflects high expectations. The company possesses a strong structural moat in optical transceivers and lasers. While trading at a premium (43x Forward P/E), the massive secular tailwinds in datacenter connectivity justify the multiple. My weighted fair value of $357 indicates mild upside, making it a solid HOLD/BUY for infrastructure exposure.

aiThesis.rationale: Coherent is a critical enabler of the AI datacenter buildout, dominating the optical transceiver and networking components market. The 376% 1-year run perfectly tracks the surge in AI infrastructure spending. Piotroski F-Score of 7 and improving operating margins (from 1.5% to 9.2%) demonstrate strong operational leverage. At a $61B market cap, it trades at roughly 10x sales and 43x forward P/E, pricing in significant future margin expansion. The base case ($381 PV) assumes they reach 18% net margins on 18% annualized growth. Given their structural moat in photonics, this premium is warranted.
